decision: neither is shown. Our distance per team is 9.6% off against 5.0% for a constant rate (the other matches' mean metres per team-second), [+0.007, +0.086]: worse. The share is about 0.5 in every match (constant error 0.008), so it says little either way.
reading: ours is below the truth in all 20 team-matches (truth / ours 1.01-1.24): our 1-s speeds miss fast or unseen players; the truth's teams do not help (12.1%), so it is not the team labels. A constant rate already gets within 5%: distance per team over a period mostly measures the period's length here.
